findings.issue: 何 before を is read なに, not なん (なん only before だ/で/と/の and counters). なんをいいだすかな is a wrong reading of 何を言い出すかな — likely a tokenizer artifact.
Token 何 has reading なん, but before the particle を the standard reading is なに (nani o).
Romaji encodes the same wrong reading nan+o ("nano..."); should reflect なにを = nanio (punctuation handling is a separate known issue).

ほやほや is classified as giongo (sound-mimicking word); it is actually gitaigo (state-mimicking mimetic — nothing sonic). The en version correctly says only 'mimetic'. Teaches a wrong lexical classification.
findings.current: vem ほやほや, um adjetivo expressivo (giongo) que reforça a ideia
findings.suggested: vem ほやほや, um adjetivo expressivo (mimético, gitaigo) que reforça a ideia

findings.issue: パーティー (ぱーてぃー) romanized with "tei" for てぃ; てぃ = ti ("tei" would be てい). Under the file's own scheme (ー→"-") it should be pa-ti-.
English word "coverage" left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation.
findings.current: O foco é coverage de 大勢 e do verbo 来る no passado educado.
findings.suggested: O foco é a cobertura de 大勢 e do verbo 来る no passado educado.

findings.issue: Gloss of 白い carries a spurious "(plural)" tag — 白い is not plural-marked; the annotation is nonsensical and could confuse learners (pt gloss is just "branco").
Typo "apreciado(o)" — stray duplicated "(o)" at the end of the literal translation.
findings.current: Livro(s) [obj] ler [o ato de] [suj] é apreciado(o).
findings.suggested: Livro(s) [obj] ler [o ato de] [suj] é apreciado.

findings.issue: Secondary gloss "fogareiro" (portable cooking stove) is not a sense of ストーブ, which denotes a heating device only; misleading in a sentence about a heater going out.
